title: Acha, brother of Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 56b, where Rav says, “There is none greater among penitents in our generation”—who is he? Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba. Some say Acha, brother of Abba, the father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba; the master says Abba and Acha were brothers.

notes.text: Abba and Acha are explicitly brothers. The alternative penitents are not automatically merged; Yirmiyah’s full patronymic is retained.
The consulted Shabbat passage first names Josiah in his generation, then gives Abba or Acha as the alternative for Rav’s generation.
